authority: PLAN_forex_v3.md section 6 P3; frozen BEFORE any proposal generation; no PnL computed in Phase P

v3_decision_clock.rule: daily-or-slower HARD precondition; intraday decision clocks forbidden
v3_decision_clock.decision_point: completed 16:00 America/New_York flat bar (daily clock) or a weekly/monthly boundary the proposal freezes ex ante
v3_decision_clock.fill: next-session fill at the following 16:00-NY bar after the decision event (one-event lag rule inherited: one-event lag on any signal derived from a bar)
v3_decision_clock.session_entry_gate: Sun 21:00 America/New_York -> Fri 16:00 New York (frozen, outcome-blind, inherited)

v3_cost_schedule.base: 1.5 bps/side on notional, charged once per side
v3_cost_schedule.stress_application: F1-FIXED: tier multipliers applied to BOOKED stress PnL via the P1 kernel book_stress; base/tier1.5/tier2.0 rows must be pairwise distinct when trades non-empty
v3_cost_schedule.delay_stress: frozen one-event delay carried as a SEPARATE stress component, never blended into cost tiers (lesson V3-L2)

v3_dual_book.mandate: every scored cell books BOTH price_only_pnl_usd and financing_adjusted_pnl_usd as separate immutable digest-covered columns
v3_dual_book.mandatory_for: all arms; decisive for carry-adjacent (rate-differential) arms
v3_dual_book.financing_gate: financing term must not manufacture the edge: the price-only book must not invert the sign of the anchor expectancy (PLAN_forex_v3.md section 12)

v3_financing_formula.authorized_basis: policy-rate differentials from adopted ECB SDMX EXR / BIS WS_CBPOL series ONLY, availability-gated (a day's differential is read only if its available_time_utc <= that day's decision timestamp)
v3_financing_formula.formula: financing_adjusted_pnl = price_only_pnl + sign * notional_usd * (r_base - r_quote) * holding_days/365, accrued per calendar day at the day-start as-of differential; sign=+1 for long base/short quote, -1 for short base/long quote
v3_financing_formula.disclosed_approximation: policy rates are unsecured official rates, NOT swap/OIS-implied rollover; every carry-adjacent proposal must disclose this approximation (PLAN_forex_v3.md section 2)
v3_financing_formula.ineligibility: proposals whose economics depend on financing precision beyond policy-rate differentials are INELIGIBLE absent an owner-authorized source (HISTORICAL_ROLLOVER_FINANCING UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED)

v3_benchmark_treatment.incremental_alpha_benchmark: the SAME mechanism with macro conditioning removed, at identical decision clock, fills, universe, warmup and costs
v3_benchmark_treatment.gate: overall incremental alpha > 0 vs this benchmark (PLAN_forex_v3.md section 12); positive raw PnL never overrides a failed incremental alpha or a firing control

v3_sample_floors.min_meaningful_drop_one: drop-one pair and drop-one fold survival per inherited dropout_survival_min_of_7
v3_sample_floors.macro_conditioning_quorum: at least 3 of 6 proposals must condition on adopted macro series (ECB/BIS)

resource_contract.machine: 8GB Apple M1, 8 logical cores (4 performance), shared with foreign cycles
resource_contract.heavy_cap: one heavy lane at a time; scored arms strictly serial; full pytest alone with zero heavy workers

no_pnl_in_phase_P: confirmed: only accounting fixtures and offline-adapter tests were run; zero real strategy PnL computed
